# Data
```{r}


famines <- read.csv("../processed data/famine_region_data.csv") %>% mutate(Decade = floor(Year/10)*10) %>% 
  #sort years within region
  arrange(Region, Year) 


fishprice <- read.csv('../processed data/fishprice_enso.csv') %>% 
  mutate(Decade = floor(Year / 10) * 10) %>%
  dplyr::select(LocationSpecies,Year, Decade, everything()) %>% 
  #create a logprice_diff variable
  arrange(LocationSpecies, Year) %>%
  group_by(LocationSpecies) %>%
  mutate(logprice_diff = logprice - lag(logprice)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

price <- read.csv('../processed data/price_2023_enso.csv')
#put Location and Year as first columns
price <- price %>% 
    mutate(Decade = floor(Year / 10) * 10) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Location,Year,Decade, everything()) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(Location, Year) %>% 
  group_by(Location) %>%
  mutate(logprice_diff = logprice - lag(logprice)) %>%
  ungroup()




```




# Non Linearity


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}

# Linear
m_lin <- feols(
  f(logprice, 1) - l(logprice, 1) ~ 
    nino34 + 
    i(Decade) | Location,
  data = price,
  panel.id = c("Location", "Year"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year
)

# Quadratic
m_p2 <- feols(
  f(logprice, 1) - l(logprice, 1) ~  poly(nino34,2,raw=T) + 
    i(Decade) | Location,
  data = price,
  panel.id = c("Location", "Year"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year
)

# Cubic
m_p3 <- feols(
  f(logprice, 1) - l(logprice, 1) ~ poly(nino34,3,raw=T) +
    i(Decade) | Location,
  data = price,
  panel.id = c("Location", "Year"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year
)

# Helper to generate predictions over a grid
make_pred <- function(model, label) {
  useful::predict_poly(
    model, "nino34",
    min = -1, max = 1.5,
    ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
    xvar_name = "nino34"
  ) %>%
    mutate(spec = label)
}

# Predictions
rf_lin <- make_pred(m_lin, "Linear")
rf_p2  <- make_pred(m_p2,  "Quadratic")
rf_p3  <- make_pred(m_p3,  "Cubic")

# Combine
rf_all <- bind_rows(rf_lin, rf_p2, rf_p3) %>%
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = c("Linear", "Quadratic", "Cubic")))

# Plot
ggplot(rf_all, aes(x = nino34, y = response)) +
  geom_line(color = "cornflowerblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~spec, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "NINO3.4 Index",
    y = "Estimated Effect on Price Growth"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)
ggsave("../figures/plots/ED_nonlin_price.pdf")
```





```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#--- Estimate models ---
m_lin <- feols(
  Famine_start ~ nino34  | Region,
  data = famines %>% filter(Region == "Central Europe"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year,
  panel.id = c("Region", "Year")
)

m_p2 <- feols(
  Famine_start ~ poly(nino34, 2, raw = TRUE) |Region ,
  data = famines %>% filter(Region == "Central Europe"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year,
  panel.id = c("Region", "Year")
)

m_p3 <- feols(
  Famine_start ~ poly(nino34, 3, raw = TRUE) | Region,
  data = famines %>% filter(Region == "Central Europe"),
  vcov = DK ~ Year,
  panel.id = c("Region", "Year")
)

#--- Predictions ---
rf_lin <- useful::predict_poly(m_lin, "nino34", min = -1, max = 1.5,
                              ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
                              xvar_name = "nino34") %>%
  mutate(spec = "Linear")

rf_p2 <- useful::predict_poly(m_p2, "nino34", min = -1, max = 1.5,
                             ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
                             xvar_name = "nino34") %>%
  mutate(spec = "Quadratic")

rf_p3 <- useful::predict_poly(m_p3, "nino34", min = -1, max = 1.5,
                             ref = 0, step.length = 0.01,
                             xvar_name = "nino34") %>%
  mutate(spec = "Cubic")

rf_all <- bind_rows(rf_lin, rf_p2, rf_p3)%>%
  mutate(spec = factor(spec, levels = c("Linear", "Quadratic", "Cubic")))

#--- Plot ---
ggplot(rf_all, aes(x = nino34, y = response)) +
  geom_line(color = "cornflowerblue", size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "cornflowerblue", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~spec, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "NINO3.4 Index",
    y = "Estimated Effect on Famine Start Probability"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)
ggsave("../figures/plots/nonlinearity_onset.pdf", device = cairo_pdf)
```


# TYW

```{r}
m_onset <- feols(
  Famine_start ~ nino34:Region  | Region + Decade,
  data = famines,
  vcov = DK ~ Year,
  panel.id = c("Region", "Year")
)

m_tyw <- feols(
  Famine_start ~ nino34:Region  | Region + Decade,
  data = famines %>% filter(Year >=1648),
  vcov = DK ~ Year,
  panel.id = c("Region", "Year")
)

etable(m_onset, m_tyw, vcov = DK ~ Year,
       keep_raw = "nino34:RegionCentral",
       tex = TRUE,
       file = "../figures/plots/TYW_CE_nino34_coef.tex")
```

coef(m_onset)

# Fig 2A as contingency table: Fisher's exact test

NINO3.4 dichotomised at 0 (El Niño vs neutral/La Niña) × Famine onset (yes/no),
Central Europe only.

```{r fisher-fig2a}
ce <- famines %>%
  filter(Region == "Central Europe") %>%
  mutate(
    ElNino      = ifelse(nino34 > 0, "NINO3.4 > 0", "NINO3.4 <= 0"),
    FamineOnset = ifelse(Famine_start == 1, "Famine", "No Famine")
  )

ct <- table(ElNino = ce$ElNino, FamineOnset = ce$FamineOnset)
print(ct)

# Reorder so NINO3.4 > 0 is the first row → OR > 1 means El Niño increases famine odds
ct_ord <- ct[c("NINO3.4 > 0", "NINO3.4 <= 0"), c("Famine", "No Famine")]

ft <- fisher.test(ct_ord, alternative = "greater")
cat(sprintf("\nFisher's exact test (one-sided: El Niño → more famines)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Odds ratio: %.3f\n", ft$estimate))
cat(sprintf("  95%% CI:    [%.3f, Inf]\n", ft$conf.int[1]))
cat(sprintf("  p-value:   %.4f\n", ft$p.value))
```

```{r fisher-latex}
out_tab <- "../analysis/output/tables"
dir.create(out_tab, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

lines <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[h]",
  "\\centering",
  paste0("\\caption*{Contingency table: NINO3.4 sign $\\times$ famine onset (Central Europe, 1500--1800). ",
         "Fisher's exact test (one-sided, El Ni\\~{n}o $\\to$ more famines): ",
         sprintf("odds ratio = %.2f (95\\%% CI: %.2f, $\\infty$), $p = %.4f$.}", ft$estimate, ft$conf.int[1], ft$p.value)),
  "\\label{tab:contingency_fisher}",
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcc}",
  "\\toprule",
  " & \\textbf{Famine onset} & \\textbf{No famine} \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  sprintf("\\textbf{NINO3.4 $> 0$}    & %d & %d \\\\",
          ct_ord["NINO3.4 > 0",  "Famine"], ct_ord["NINO3.4 > 0",  "No Famine"]),
  sprintf("\\textbf{NINO3.4 $\\leq 0$} & %d & %d \\\\",
          ct_ord["NINO3.4 <= 0", "Famine"], ct_ord["NINO3.4 <= 0", "No Famine"]),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}",
  "\\end{table}"
)

writeLines(lines, file.path(out_tab, "contingency.tex"))
cat("Saved contingency.tex\n")
```
